status: Post-generation exploratory specification; recorded before this registration and unblinding, not preregistered
unit: 12 paired cases, one per fictional speaker; eight conditions per case
coding: Numeric 1-5 ratings retained; Correct=1 and Incorrect=0 only for applicable factual/temporal outcomes; Unverifiable remains missing, not zero. Completeness and structural status analyzed separately.
factorial_scaling: Average on-off main differences /4; pairwise differences-in-differences /2 over remaining factor; triple difference-in-differences-in-differences /1.
weighting: Equal paired-case weights within frozen eligibility; no C0-correct selection
uncertainty: Case-level range, leave-one-case-out range, and family-stratified whole-case percentile bootstrap; 10000 draws, seed 713113. Ordinal rating means are descriptive score-point summaries. Degenerate ceiling intervals do not imply population certainty.
multiple_testing: No confirmatory tests, adjusted p-values, discovery selection or significance claims
missingness: Retain all frozen eligible cases; report missing contrasts explicitly; no imputation
constraint_diagnostic: Separate exploratory description using source narrative categories: complete greeting with constraint violation, unfinished reasoning, direct supported answer; no alteration to primary applicability or ratings
control_review: 24 P1 controls remain OPEN; no matched-control outcomes or contrasts
unblinding_scope: Existing curator mapping read only after immutable researcher registration. Analysts may already know historical treatment results; no claim of analyst blindness.
